title: Single Window Facilitation Framework (MAITRI 2.0)
authority: Maharashtra Industry, Trade and Investment Facilitation Cell (MAITRI)
short_summary: Under the Maharashtra Industry Facilitation Act, entrepreneurs can submit a Combined Application Form (CAF) covering over 40 industrial services across 16 state departments. All statutory approvals are issued through the unified single-window portal without requiring in-person visits to physical departmental offices.

title: Right to Public Services Act (RTS Maharashtra)
authority: Maharashtra State Right to Services Commission
section_label: Section 3 & 7 - Mandated Time Bounds & Deemed Delivery
short_summary: The Maharashtra Right to Public Services Act 2015 guarantees time-bound delivery of notified industrial approvals. If a competent authority fails to decide on an application within statutory SLA days without raising a lawful query, applicant can seek deemed approval or escalate to First Appellate Authority.

title: Consent to Establish (CTE) Requirements
section_label: Water Act 1974 Sec 25 & Air Act 1981 Sec 21
short_summary: Consent to Establish (CTE) is mandatory prior to initiating any site construction or plant erection for industries falling under Red, Orange, or Green pollution categories. Applications must be accompanied by detailed manufacturing process flowcharts, water balance sheets, and proposed effluent treatment plant (ETP) schemes.

title: Consent to Operate (CTO) & Renewal
short_summary: Consent to Operate (CTO) must be secured after construction completion and before commencement of commercial manufacturing. MPCB verifies installation and trial functioning of environmental control equipment (ETP, STP, bag filters). Operating consents are granted for 1 to 5 years depending on industrial hazard classification.

title: Hazardous Waste Handling Authorisation
short_summary: Any unit generating hazardous waste (such as spent solvents, chemical sludge, used oil, or contaminated containers) must obtain Authorisation in Form 2. The unit must demonstrate membership with a Common Hazardous Waste Treatment, Storage, and Disposal Facility (CHWTSDF) such as MEPL or MWML.

title: Provisional Fire Safety Clearance (Fire NOC)
authority: Maharashtra Fire Services / MIDC Fire Brigade
short_summary: Provisional Fire NOC is required to validate architectural layout drawings against statutory fire safety codes prior to building sanction. The clearance specifies requirements for fire hydrant rings, underground static water reservoirs, fire detection systems, and dedicated wide perimeter access for emergency fire tenders.

title: Final Fire Safety Certificate (Occupancy NOC)
authority: Maharashtra Fire Services / MIDC Fire Brigade
section_label: Form A/B Inspection and Testing Certificate
short_summary: Prior to occupying an industrial building, the unit must obtain a Final Fire Certificate. A certified fire safety agency must submit Form A certifying that all firefighting installations (sprinklers, alarms, hose reels, pumps) have been fully erected and pressure-tested as per the provisional clearance.

title: Factory Plan Approval
authority: Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH)
short_summary: Before constructing or extending any factory building employing 10 or more workers with power, plans must be approved by DISH. The drawings must verify adequate internal roadway width, clear machinery spacing, lighting, ventilation, and emergency exit routes conforming to safety standards.

title: Factory Licence Grant and Registration
authority: Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH)
short_summary: A factory licence must be obtained at least 15 days before initiating manufacturing. The occupier must submit Form 2 (Notice of Occupation) along with a Certificate of Stability in Form 1A signed by an authorized structural chartered engineer.

title: Boiler Registration and Hydraulic Testing
short_summary: Every steam boiler and economizer must be registered with the Directorate of Steam Boilers prior to being put into service. An inspector inspects the equipment, witnesses a hydraulic pressure test at 1.5 times the working pressure, and issues a certificate specifying the maximum permissible working pressure.

title: Udyam MSME Registration Procedure
authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises / DIC
short_summary: Udyam Registration is a completely paperless, self-declaration-based online registration for Micro, Small, and Medium enterprises. Classification is determined by investment in plant & machinery and annual turnover linked automatically via PAN and GSTN databases.

title: MIDC Industrial Land Allotment & Building Sanction
section_label: MIDC Disposal of Land Regulations & DCR
short_summary: In planned MIDC industrial estates, building plan sanction is granted directly by the MIDC Special Planning Authority (SPA). Since the land is pre-zoned for industrial use, entrepreneurs are exempt from separate Non-Agricultural (NA) conversion permissions.

title: Non-Agricultural (NA) Land Permission (Non-MIDC)
short_summary: For industrial projects outside MIDC zones on privately held agricultural land, formal conversion to Non-Agricultural (NA) industrial use must be obtained from the District Collector or Sub-Divisional Officer after obtaining zonal town planning clearance.

title: Industrial Electricity Grid Connection
authority: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (MSEDCL)
section_label: MSEDCL Industrial Supply Code & MERC Regulations
short_summary: High Tension (HT) and Low Tension (LT) industrial electricity connections are applied through the single-window portal. MSEDCL conducts technical feasibility of the nearest substation, issues a demand note for infrastructure charges, and releases power following safety inspection by the Electrical Inspector.

title: Industrial Water Connection (MIDC & Municipal)
authority: MIDC Water Works / Urban Local Body
short_summary: Industrial water connections in MIDC areas are sanctioned based on the water balance sheet submitted by the unit. Pipeline tapping, water meter calibration, and supply release are governed by statutory 15-day service-level agreements.

title: Legal Metrology Packaged Commodities Registration
short_summary: Every manufacturer or packer who pre-packages commodities for commercial retail or wholesale sale must register their manufacturing facility with the Controller of Legal Metrology. Packaging labels must display net quantity, MRP, manufacturing date, and consumer grievance contact.

title: Contract Labour Principal Employer Registration
authority: Office of the Commissioner of Labour
short_summary: Any industrial establishment employing 50 or more contract workers on any day must register as a Principal Employer with the registering officer of the local Labour Commissionerate. Contractors providing manpower must hold corresponding labour contractor licences.

title: Food Safety Manufacturing Licence (FSSAI / FDA)
section_label: Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 Section 31
short_summary: Food processing units with production capacity over 100 kg/day or annual turnover over ₹12 Lakh must obtain a State FSSAI Food Business Manufacturing Licence. Facilities must implement sanitary standard operating procedures (SSOP) and maintain certified water potability test reports.

title: Pharmaceutical Drug Manufacturing Licence
short_summary: Manufacturing of pharmaceutical formulations or active bulk drugs requires licences in Form 25/28 from FDA Maharashtra. Facilities must comply with WHO-GMP Schedule M specifications, validation of cleanroom HVAC systems, and employment of approved manufacturing and analytical chemists.

title: Prior Environmental Clearance (EC Category B)
short_summary: Chemical, bulk drug, and large-scale industrial projects listed in Schedule Category B require prior Environmental Clearance from SEIAA Maharashtra. The process involves Terms of Reference (ToR) approval, baseline environmental monitoring, EIA report preparation, and State Expert Appraisal Committee (SEAC) review.

title: Deemed Approvals under Maharashtra Facilitation Law
short_summary: Under the Maharashtra Industry Facilitation Framework, if a designated department fails to approve or reject an application within statutory SLA days and no legitimate query is pending, the portal can generate an automated Deemed Approval Certificate with full legal validity.

title: Common Joint Inspection System Reforms
authority: Directorate of Industries / MAITRI Nodal Cell
section_label: Ease of Doing Business Inspection Reform Mandate
short_summary: To eliminate harassment from multiple uncoordinated departmental inspections, Maharashtra implements the Common Inspection System. Inspections by Pollution Control, Fire Services, DISH (Factories), Labour, and Legal Metrology are synchronized into a single joint visit with mandatory prior notice and 48-hour online report uploading.

title: Risk-Based Inspection and Scrutiny Protocol
authority: State Empowered Committee on Regulatory Compliance
short_summary: Industrial applications are classified into Fast Track, Standard, or Detailed Scrutiny based on objective hazard scores, investment volume, and effluent profile. Fast Track enterprises benefit from reduced documentation, shortened SLA timelines, and exemption from routine pre-commissioning physical inspections.

title: Package Scheme of Incentives (PSI) Overview
short_summary: The Package Scheme of Incentives provides financial assistance to industrial units based on geographic development tiers (Zone A to Zone D+). Eligible units can claim industrial capital subsidies, SGST fiscal incentives, electricity duty exemptions, and interest subvention for eligible investments.

title: Industrial Electricity Duty Exemption Scheme
short_summary: Eligible new industrial manufacturing units and units undertaking substantial capacity expansion in notified backward talukas (Zones B, C, D, D+) are 100% exempt from payment of state electricity duty for periods ranging from 7 to 10 years from the date of commercial production.

title: Stamp Duty and Registration Fee Exemption
section_label: Bombay Stamp Act 1958 Section 9 Remission Orders
short_summary: Industrial enterprises acquiring land, executing lease agreements with MIDC, or executing mortgage deeds for term loans in notified industrial backward zones enjoy 100% exemption or concessional stamp duty under the State Industrial Policy.

title: MSME Interest Subvention Scheme
authority: Directorate of Industries / MSME Development Cell
short_summary: Micro and Small industrial enterprises availing term loans from scheduled commercial banks for plant and machinery procurement are eligible for 5% annual interest subvention for up to 5 years, capped at ₹25 Lakh to ₹50 Lakh depending on district tier classification.

title: MSME Green and Cleaner Technology Assistance
authority: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board & Directorate of Industries
short_summary: Assistance is granted to MSMEs installing energy-efficient machinery, rooftop solar, zero-liquid-discharge (ZLD) effluent plants, or adopting water recycling technologies. Financial assistance covers up to 50% of equipment cost, capped at ₹50 Lakh.

title: Export Promotion Support Scheme
short_summary: Enterprises engaged in manufacturing goods for international export are eligible for freight subsidies, international quality certification reimbursements (such as ISO, CE mark, US-FDA certifications), and participation subsidies for overseas industrial trade fairs.

title: Statutory Query Management and Clock Pausing Rules
section_label: Section 8 - Procedural Discipline for Departmental Queries
short_summary: Departmental officers are permitted to raise clarifications or request missing documents only ONCE within the initial scrutiny period. The statutory SLA clock is automatically paused while awaiting the applicant's response and resumes immediately upon submission.

title: Three-Tier Grievance Redressal and Appeals Matrix
authority: Right to Public Services Appellate Tribunal
short_summary: Applicants aggrieved by rejection or statutory SLA delay can file appeals across 3 defined levels: Level 1 Department Nodal Officer; Level 2 MAITRI Nodal Admin (after 3 days of unresolved SLA breach); Level 3 State Competent Authority / RTS Commissioner (after 7 days).

title: Verified Data Vault and Document Reuse Policy
short_summary: Verified core enterprise attributes (PAN, Udyam number, MIDC plot allotment details, GSTIN) are securely vaulted. Once verified by any authorized department, they are automatically reused across subsequent approval applications to avoid repetitive uploads.

title: Petroleum & Flammable Materials Storage Licencing (PESO)
authority: Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organization (PESO) / Fire
short_summary: Industrial enterprises storing bulk class A, B, or C petroleum products, LPG bulk tanks, or flammable chemicals above exempted threshold limits must obtain site clearance and storage licences from PESO along with District Magistrate / Fire Services concurrence.

title: Industrial Lift and Freight Elevator Licencing
section_label: Maharashtra Lifts, Escalators & Moving Walks Act 2017
short_summary: Permission to erect and operate passenger or industrial goods elevators requires prior submission of structural drawings, safety gear test certificates, and inspection by the Government Lift Inspector before commissioning.

title: Tree Transit and Felling Permissions in Industrial Zones
authority: Tree Authority, Urban Development / Forest Department
section_label: Maharashtra Protection & Preservation of Trees Act 1975
short_summary: Clearing trees for industrial site grading requires application to the local Tree Authority. Units must commit to compensatory plantation (typically 3 to 5 saplings per tree cut) and deposit security guarantees.

title: Professional Tax Registration (PTEC & PTRC)
authority: Department of Goods and Services Tax, Maharashtra
short_summary: Industrial companies must obtain Profession Tax Enrolment Certificate (PTEC) for the enterprise itself, and Profession Tax Registration Certificate (PTRC) to deduct and remit statutory profession tax from employee monthly wages.

title: GST Registration Protocols for Manufacturing
short_summary: Mandatory tax registration for manufacturing entities with aggregate turnover exceeding statutory threshold. Applications are validated against Aadhaar biometric authentication of authorized signatories and verified premises documentation.

title: Provident Fund (EPFO) & Employee State Insurance (ESIC)
section_label: EPF Act 1952 & ESI Act 1948 Joint Registration
short_summary: Factories engaging 20 or more persons are compulsorily covered under EPFO. Establishments engaging 10 or more employees with wages up to ₹21,000 per month are covered under ESIC for medical, maternity, and disability coverage.

title: Standing Orders Certification for Industrial Staff
authority: Office of the Commissioner of Labour
short_summary: Every industrial establishment employing 50 or more workmen must submit draft standing orders defining terms of employment, working hours, shift allocation, leave entitlement, and disciplinary procedure to the Certifying Officer.

title: Municipal Trade Licence in Industrial and Mixed Zones
short_summary: Establishments operating within municipal or panchayat jurisdictions must obtain a Municipal Trade Licence verifying trade sanitation, nuisance control, and solid waste segregation compliance.

title: Plastic Waste Management Registration
section_label: Plastic Waste Management Rules 2016 & Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)
short_summary: Producers, importers, and brand owners (PIBOs) of plastic packaging or virgin plastic raw material processors must register under the MPCB EPR portal and fulfill annual post-consumer plastic collection targets.

title: Demarcation of Power Quality and Open Access Norms
section_label: MERC Open Access Regulations & Reliability Standards
short_summary: Industrial consumers with connected load of 1 MW and above have the statutory right to source green or open-market electrical power through open access transmission while maintaining dedicated standby supply agreements with MSEDCL.
